sources.author: RailOne
patch_list: Allow screenshots

Removes the FLAG_SECURE restriction that makes screenshots and screen recordings of the app come out black. The in-app WebView (WavesActivity) stops applying it, and the bundled no_screenshot plugin's own FLAG_SECURE hook is neutered so no…
Bypass rjsniffer ADB check
Neutralises the rjsniffer library's own adb_enabled check. It runs in the app's isolated :com.emrys.rjsniffer.rjsniffer.Sniffer process, independently of the main app.
Bypass signature verification
Forces the app's own signing-certificate check (SHA-256 of the APK signature) to return true, so a re-signed build is accepted by the Flutter layer.
Bypass USB-debugging detection
Forces the adb_enabled, adb_wifi_enabled and development_settings_enabled checks to return false, so the app runs normally while USB debugging / developer options are on.
Disable native security SDK

Stops AikyamApplication.onCreate() from loading libnative-lib.so, disarming the native anti-tamper SDK that force-stops the app and wipes its data. Root cause fix: the other patches only matter once this one is applied.
Hide screenshot detection

Stops the bundled no_screenshot plugin from registering its MediaStore ContentObserver, so screenshot and screen-recording detection never becomes active and no detection event is delivered to the app's Flutter layer.
Monochrome icon support
Adds the missing monochrome layer to the adaptive icon, so themed-icon launchers (Material You) can tint RailOne's icon instead of showing it untinted.
